about_the_game:
In this brutal game that combines Russian roulette and reasoning, you will hold a revolver and sit at a gambling table full of lies and death. Every bullet may be your end, and the three people sitting in front of you... are waiting to execute you when you relax.

 

[Game Background]

 

In a remote castle, four completely different women are sitting at a round table. They don't know each other, but they are led here because of an unknown letter. From their expressions, everyone has some secrets. A thunder broke the silence. A voice came from the empty hall.

 

“Night phase begins. Close your eyes“

 

★ Classic gameplay innovation

 

Basic rules: Four players participate in Russian roulette, and each pull of the trigger is a 50% chance of survival

 

Identity hunting: Angel/Demon/God/Heretic four identities, each with different hunting targets and exclusive skills

 

Prop matching: Unique prop mechanism, which can affect the entire battle at any time

 

Paradox victory: Heretic will win immediately after ending themselves

 

★ Deadly reasoning link

 

First night prophecy: Please close your eyes when it gets dark-all players get an identity verification opportunity

 

Behavior analysis: Determine the true identity of the opponent through micro-operations such as shooting selection, skill release, and prop use

 

Identity game: Everyone is a prey and a hunter, don't expose your identity easily

 

Heretic trap: Be careful of the player who wants to end himself, his victory will make everyone buried with him!

 

[Game Features]

 

▶ Each round is a 15-20 minute high-intensity psychological game

 

▶ Supports 4-player online confrontation, and each round randomly obtains a unique identity

 

▶ Special execution animations that make people's blood boil

 

[Character Introduction]

 

[Saori]

 

She looks innocent and a good girl in the eyes of people around her. No one would have thought of her true identity - a vampire! Or rather, everyone who knew this secret disappeared quietly.

 

[Vela Kolt]

 

Everyone thinks that this policewoman is too strong, but they don't know that she has a masochistic habit in private. Her true identity is a wolf hidden among humans. When she is emotional, her ears and tail will be exposed.

 

[Nicky]

 

The traces of stitches on her face make it hard to imagine what she has been through. Her empty words and mechanical movements make people feel a little cold when talking to her.

 

[Isabelle]

 

A tall nun. According to rumors, no man can look at her for three seconds. Because men who see her can't help but... She always wears a top hat on weekdays, making it difficult to see her expression.

 

[Developer Warning]

 

This game may cause:

✓Permanent damage to trust between friends

 

Are you ready to step into this world of lies that is more dangerous than bullets?

content_descriptors.notes: The game may contain some content that is not suitable for all ages: players can use props to attack each other, and the costume designs of some characters may be exposed.

Each role hides its own Hunting List—protect your identity while figuring out others’. Lock onto your target: Bang! One More Bang!"
